intent: 为 evopilot-harness 增加 Harness 专用 LLM 初始化闭环：WorkBuddy 等第三方 Agent Host 安装或升级数字专家后，检查外部 Workspace 的模型配置；引导用户在本机安全创建或选择 models.json；执行配置校验和最小连通性 doctor；只有达到 CONFIGURED_AND_VERIFIED 才完成初始化；后续 Advisor 和 Proposal Review 默认复用该 Workspace 配置；不得读取或导入 Host 凭据、不得将密钥写入聊天或 Session、不得让 Host LLM 取代独立 Reviewer
objective: 在不接触第三方 Agent Host 凭据的前提下，使 Harness 专用 LLM 完成一次安全配置、连通性验证和后续 Workspace 默认复用，并准确区分产品安装状态与 LLM 初始化状态。

include: Separate installed-product status from Harness LLM initialization readiness
Expose host-neutral LLM readiness through Agent bootstrap and installer lifecycle results
Prepare a credential-free Workspace model template without creating or overwriting models.json
Guide local human configuration and run configuration inspection plus a minimal live doctor
Persist a secret-free verification binding and default Advisor and Proposal Review to the Workspace model configuration
Provide WorkBuddy guidance while keeping the common contract host-neutral
Add deterministic tests, public-package checks, documentation, migration compatibility, and real WorkBuddy acceptance evidence
exclude: Reading, copying, importing, or exposing WorkBuddy or another Agent host credential
Passing raw credentials through conversation, MCP arguments, Session state, logs, screenshots, or acceptance artifacts
Using the host conversation LLM as the Harness Advisor or independent Proposal semantic reviewer
Overwriting a human-maintained models.json or silently changing Advisor mode
Changing Engine approval, publication, Catalog, source-execution, or product-boundary authority
Commit, push, tag, GitHub Release, npm publication, GHCR, cloud deployment, or remote-service deployment

acceptance.criterion: Installed-product and LLM-initialization states are structurally separate.
Agent bootstrap returns structured LLM readiness.
An absent configuration produces only a credential-free example and guidance.
Existing models.json content is never overwritten.
Model paths and file permissions remain inside the approved external configuration boundary.
The operator can explicitly select a models file and profile without exposing credentials.
Configuration inspection never returns API keys or other secrets.
Doctor performs a minimal live connectivity check.
Successful inspection and doctor yield CONFIGURED_AND_VERIFIED with a secret-free binding.
Later Sessions default to the verified Workspace model configuration.
The WorkBuddy Digital Expert presents the initialization journey in natural language.
The shared Core contains no WorkBuddy-private fields or operations.
Deterministic flows that do not require an LLM remain operable when LLM readiness is incomplete.
LLM-required Advisor or Review stops with an exact actionable readiness blocker.
Advisor and Proposal Review resolve the same verified configuration binding.
Conversation, Session, log, and evidence surfaces contain no model credential.
Install, upgrade, and repair are idempotent and preserve human configuration.
A v4.2.3 npm candidate tarball completes LLM initialization and default Workspace reuse in a real WorkBuddy host without source-checkout resolution.

postReleaseVerification: Rerun the real WorkBuddy acceptance from the exact public Registry package and retain redacted evidence
